# docling-parser

> Universal PDF/PPTX document parser with vision-based design intelligence.
> Ships as a FastMCP server + CLI. Extracts text, tables, color palettes,
> layout analysis, and full design systems from any document.

## Start Here

- Agent instructions: AGENTS.md
- API reference: README.md
- Skill (for harness agents): skills/docling-parser/SKILL.md
- Cross-session memory: MEMORY.md

## Architecture

- Core parser (Docling-backed): src/docling_parser/converter.py
- Vision pipeline (render + VLM): src/docling_parser/vision.py
- Color extraction (PIL quantization): src/docling_parser/color.py
- Design system synthesis (VLM): src/docling_parser/design_system.py
- File persistence + browsing: src/docling_parser/storage.py
- MCP server (5 tools): src/docling_parser/server.py
- CLI (convert, design-system, list, page, summary): src/docling_parser/cli.py
- Normalized JSON schema: src/docling_parser/normalizer.py

## MCP Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `parse_document(source, output_format, vision, save)` | Parse to markdown/JSON, optionally with vision analysis |
| `build_design_system(source, save)` | Extract a design system (tokens + components + guidelines) |
| `list_parsed()` | Browse all previously parsed documents (metadata only) |
| `get_page(source, page_number)` | Get a single page's vision analysis |
| `get_summary(source)` | Get document-level summary |

## CLI Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `docling-parser convert <source> [--vision] [--save] [-o file]` | Convert a document |
| `docling-parser design-system <source> [--save] [-o file]` | Extract a design system |
| `docling-parser list` | List parsed documents |
| `docling-parser page <source> <n>` | Get a single page's analysis |
| `docling-parser summary <source>` | Get document summary |

## Source-Of-Truth Files

- Project config: pyproject.toml
- MCP server entry: src/docling_parser/server.py
- CLI entry: src/docling_parser/cli.py
- Vision config (env vars): src/docling_parser/vision.py (VisionConfig.from_env)
- Output dir config: DOCLING_PARSER_OUTPUT_DIR env var (default: docling-output/)
- Skill: skills/docling-parser/SKILL.md

## Validation Commands

- Run tests: `uv run pytest`
- Lint: `uv run ruff check src/ tests/`
- Full check: `uv run ruff check src/ tests/ && uv run pytest -q`
- MCP server test: `uv run docling-parser-mcp` (stdio, sends MCP initialize handshake)

## Key Dependencies

- Docling (document conversion): `docling>=2.0.0`
- FastMCP (MCP server): `fastmcp>=2.3.0`
- pymupdf (PDF rendering): `pymupdf>=1.24.0`
- python-pptx (PPTX speaker notes): `python-pptx>=1.0.0`
- json-repair (VLM JSON fixup): `json-repair>=0.30.0`
- httpx (VLM API client): `httpx>=0.27`
- LibreOffice (PPTX slide rendering): system install, `brew install --cask libreoffice`
